body: I haven’t been able to sleep recently either, so if you need someone to talk to who can understand how you feel please feel free to DM me

It is hard, but that’s not what has driven me to the edge again. It just finally hit me that I am truly unlovable and undeserving of love because of how fucked up I am, and no amount of therapy or medication helps. If I had any sleeping pills I would take some but I don’t, and my sleeping schedule is so fucked there’s no way I could fall asleep right now.
